event_name: Muckleshoot Casino Resort NHRA Northwest Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 73 degrees, relative humidity 57 percent, barometer 30.03 inches, adjusted
altitude 1,673 feet, track temperature 99 degrees.

That was the 5th perfect reaction time for Erica Enders.

Erica is 14 - 12 against Anderson in Rd. 3.

Anderson and Enders have each won 31 times against the other in prior events. 

Enders with the starting line advantage, but has severe tire shake and the car is sideways before she pushes
in the clutch.

Anderson drives through tire shake for the win.  Anderson is advancing to his sixth final this season and
197th career final.

Dallas Glenn is 4 - 1 against Greg Stanfield overall.

In their 5 races each driver has fouled out once and they have had the identical R/T once.

Stanfield with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He will have lane choice over
Anderson in the final.  He is advancing to his second final this season and 30th of his career.
